summary: Mark a Node Timeout as not keeping the event loop alive while preserving the same scheduled handle.

target.notes: Clear liveness ref state idempotently and return the receiver.

semantics.effect: timer alone no longer keeps process alive
semantics.callback: may never run if no other ref'ed work remains

caveats: unref() does not cancel the timer.

tests.name: returns same handle and clears ref
does not equal cancellation
tests.expected_behavior: ran can print because other ref'ed work keeps the loop alive
